name: export_dataset
title: export.dataset
description: Assemble the researcher-facing deliverable: bugs.csv, path_hops.csv, findings.csv, evidence.csv, run_metadata.json, and a generated CODEBOOK.md, written under workspace/exports/<runId>/dataset/. Queries the graph directly rather than trusting a prior write, and joins per-bug findings through Bug.fixSha rather than filtering strictly by runId, because evidence and findings have been observed scattered across multiple server-process runIds for one mining effort. This is the file set a researcher downloads; graph_upsert_bug and export_run persist working state but were never meant to be read directly by someone outside the project.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.

datasetDir.description: Directory containing all six written files.

bugCount.description: Bugs written to bugs.csv, admitted and rejected together.
